evidence.detail: R107 EditorKitController dispatches to this static helper only when the selected EditorEntity is an EditorNpcEntity, passing the parsed command name/arguments and the typed NPC entity.
Surviving commands are reset, select, set, set_id, setid, setnpc, sizex, stand and walk.
The helper changes the EditorNpcEntity NPC definition/id, stand/walk animation and size-related state, then refreshes its NPC model/render state.
Its transform path emits the exact Editor Kit message '@whi@<img=24> Entity transformed to @gre@... (...)!' through EditorKitController status output.

candidates.note: EditorNpcCommandHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the static NPC-specific command processor used only by EditorNpcEntity dispatch.

evidence.detail: R107 EditorKitController dispatches to this static helper only when the selected EditorEntity is an EditorPlayerEntity, passing the parsed command name/arguments and the typed player entity.
The command vocabulary includes weapon/wep, cape/back, legs/leg, gloves/glove/hand/hands, boots/boot/feet, shield, helmet/helm/hat/head, amulet/ammy/neck and chest/body/top.
It also handles male/female transforms and full_body/full_chest/full_hat/full_helm/full_mask flag variants, plus reset/off states.

Surviving Editor Kit messages explicitly say 'Set player weapon!', 'Set player cape!', 'Set player legs!', 'Entity transformed to male!' and 'Entity transformed to female!', fixing the player-specific command role.

candidates.note: EditorPlayerCommandHandler is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the static Player appearance/equipment command processor used only by EditorPlayerEntity dispatch.
